producer.intro: At Miso Kobo no Sato in Fuefuki City, Yamanashi, our shop owner Yuko Isobe continues her craft of miso-making.

producer.soybeanBody1: [EN TODO] The soybeans are grown without pesticides, exclusively by contracted farmers in Fujiyoshida at the foot of Mt. Fuji.
producer.soybeanBody2: [EN TODO] Low in oil and high in natural sugars, giving the miso its pronounced sweetness.
producer.farmerCaption: [EN TODO] A contracted farmer (at the foot of Mt. Fuji)

producer.craftBody3: [EN TODO] A 'living miso' whose fermentation is never halted. Aging time varies by product (see each product page).
